Unload a buried Hydra while its mother remains loaded, raise its slot, then reload the Hydra: exactly one existing enter animation starts and no duplicate child is spawned.
Unload a surface Hydra during a mother submerge, then unload the mother before reloading the Hydra: its world ledger applies the saved buried command even without a loaded mother.

Load an older ledger without Raised: child motion is not guessed or overwritten at join; a loaded owner later reconciles its persisted slot command.
Terminate the mother from a Hydra or Hunter EntityJoinLevel callback: no later slot/wave spawns, no concurrent modification, and the just-inserted child receives normal retirement/release cleanup.
Cancel that child insertion while also terminating the mother: provisional identity is removed, the unadded child is discarded, and no subsequent spawn attempts occur.

staticReview.cycle: GreeneBattleCycle calls onSubmerge only after RISING, onEmerge after one emergence tick, and saves hydrasSpawned/nextHydra/emergeElapsed together with the nested Brood tag. Source wave increments only on DOWN entry; Brood entry guards suppress repeated identical wave callbacks.
staticReview.surface: Brood spawn candidates use only mother X/Z plus the already-loaded chunk heightmap. Mother root sinking twenty source units does not move the candidate ground Y underground.
staticReview.unload_fix: The prior implementation stored Slot.raised but called setGreeneUnderground only if the child was currently loaded; existing non-null child IDs never retried. applyHydraState now records the desired state and reconciles existing identities, and childJoined reads it even while the mother is unloaded.
staticReview.idempotence: setGreeneUnderground now treats any existing non-4/non-11 action as aboveground, preserving combat on repeated raised requests. A genuine desired buried/raised transition still cancels the old combat/motion once.
staticReview.scope: No shared EncounterMob, GreeneBattleCycle or GreeneMotion edits in this followup. No Java, compilation, automated tests, game/client or media playback.
staticReview.spawn_reentrancy: EntityJoinLevel callbacks may kill/discard the mother while addFreshEntity is still on the stack. Spawn now checks activity before and after insertion, stops its caller after a terminated-owner callback, and finishes the existing retirement policy for a child that became visible only after dispose. Pending Hunter waves iterate a snapshot, preventing disposal clearing the list from invalidating its iterator.
staticReview.legacy_task_replacement: When a reused mother instance loads legacy NBT without GreeneBattle, the cycle disposes its previous Brood before loading an empty Brood. Disposal removes DEAD receipts and marks remaining children RETIRING; new Hydra slot recovery already excludes RETIRING. Hunter recovery now also excludes RETIRING, so an unloaded old wave with the same numerical wave index cannot consume the replacement task budget. Normal same-task DEAD Hunter receipts remain valid spent identities. Retiring rows remain in the world ledger until the old child returns, preserving cleanup; they are not globally erased.
